description: This file defines an event subscriber class 'AdministratorAccessSubscriber' that hooks into the Symfony HTTP kernel's controller event to modify user permissions based on the controller being accessed. It specifically determines whether the authenticated user has admin access when certain controller events occur.

classes.name: AdministratorAccessSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony kernel controller events to adjust admin access rights based on the controller type.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber is listening to, specifically the controller event with a high priority.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Event handler that checks the controller being accessed and sets admin access privileges accordingly.
